patthana23.51:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naparittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.51:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.51:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naappamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
